_doc: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for NEX geographic universe. Loaded by src/lib/nex/city-registry.ts (TypeScript consumers) AND by scripts/nex-* .mjs consumers (rotation tick, orchestrator tick, market/transport walkers, city-bbox-catalogue). Adding a city = one entry here. Drift is caught by src/lib/nex/city-registry.test.ts.

_schema.canonical: display name · MUST exactly match nex.*.city column values
_schema.province: display province · e.g. Bali · DKI Jakarta · East Java
_schema.region: grouping label · initially matches province · future regions may collapse multiple provinces
_schema.centroid: map centre {lat, lng} for landing hero + map
_schema.bboxSw: [lat, lng] south-west corner · used by walkers · centroid ± 0.10° (~11km)
_schema.aliases: additional accepted spellings for slug/canonical matching (never fabricated)
_schema.priority: walker rotation ORDER (ascending) · Bali=1-49 · capitals=100-149 · majors=200-399 · rest=400-799 · Yogya=900+ (Philip 2026-08-28 · deprioritized after saturation)
